title: CCS Travelling Allowance — Batch 02
speaker: voice-00 (user selected)

beats.heading: 01A  |  Batch 2: route map
beats.rule: Use the civilian official-tour and training rules; separate service instructions can apply.
beats.example: A foreign official tour needs the international table, not a copy of the domestic table.
beats.trap: Examples are hypothetical; sanction, exceptions and later orders must be checked.
beats.key: Always identify the journey, service, date, pay level and funding first.
lines: Hey everyone! Batch Two में international air, sea और road टी ए सीखेंगे।
ये Central Government civilian tour और training पर focus करता है।
Railway और Armed Forces के अलग instructions check करें।
Example: foreign tour में domestic class को copy नहीं करेंगे।
हर example hypothetical है; sanction और latest order check करें।
english_lines: In Batch 2 we study international air, sea and road travelling allowance.
The focus is Central Government civilian tours and training.
Check the separate instructions for Railways and the Armed Forces.
For example, do not copy the domestic class for a foreign tour.
Every example is hypothetical; check the sanction and latest orders.

beats.heading: 01B  |  Match the level to the international table
beats.rule: International: Level 17+ First, 14–16 Business/Club, Level 13 and below Economy; 13A follows 13.
beats.example: Level 13A checks the Economy row; Level 14 checks the Business/Club row.
beats.trap: A class entitlement is not automatic approval of a specific fare or journey.
beats.key: International air class and domestic air class are different tables.
lines: International travel में Level seventeen और ऊपर First Class है।
Level fourteen से sixteen Business या Club Class है।
Level thirteen और नीचे Economy Class है।
Level thirteen A को Level thirteen के बराबर check करेंगे।
Example: Level thirteen A में Economy; Level fourteen में Business।
लेकिन entitlement, booking और sanction तीन अलग checks हैं।
english_lines: Internationally, Level 17 and above is First Class.
Levels 14 to 16 are Business or Club Class.
Level 13 and below is Economy Class.
Check Level 13A as equivalent to Level 13.
For example, 13A checks Economy; Level 14 checks Business.
Entitlement, booking and sanction are separate checks.

sections.title: Air booking: choice and clocks
sections.source: DoE air OMs 16 Feb and 16 Jun 2022

beats.heading: 02A  |  Government-funded air tickets
beats.rule: Government-funded tickets: use the three authorised agents; a private airline may be used.
beats.example: An authorised-agent portal compares eligible-class flights in the chosen three-hour slot.
beats.trap: A 10% optimisation provision is not an unrestricted fare upgrade.
beats.key: One selected agent for all employees on a single tour; no agency convenience fee.
lines: Government पैसे दे रही हो, तो ticket तीन authorised agents से लें।
ये हैं Balmer Lawrie, Ashok Travels और IRCTC।
Private airline भी allowed है; class और sanction अलग checks हैं।
Chosen three-hour slot में cheapest eligible fare देखें।
Non-stop preferably लें; ten percent price band की rule check करें।
Example: group के एक tour के लिए एक ही selected agent use होगा।
english_lines: When the Government bears the fare, use the three authorised agents.
These are Balmer Lawrie, Ashok Travels and IRCTC.
A private airline is permitted; class and sanction remain separate checks.
Check the cheapest eligible fare in the chosen three-hour slot.
Prefer non-stop travel and check the 10% price-band provision.
For example, one selected agent is used for all staff on one tour.

beats.heading: 02B  |  Booking, cancellation and proof
beats.rule: 21 days is encouraged; late bookings and cancellations have different declaration clocks.
beats.example: A tour booking 48 hours before departure needs self-declared justification.
beats.trap: A non-authorised website needs competent relaxation; rejection is not automatic.
beats.key: Submit journey certificate within 72 hours after completion; TA bill may follow.
lines: Twenty one days पहले booking करना encouraged है।
Tour booking seventy two hours से कम पहले हो, justification दें।
Cancellation twenty four hours से कम पहले हो, अलग reason दें।
Example: forty eight hours पहले booking पर self declaration लगेगा।
Journey के बाद seventy two hours में completion certificate दें।
Unauthorised booking पर competent relaxation check करें।
english_lines: Booking 21 days in advance is encouraged.
For a tour booking less than 72 hours before travel, justify it.
Give a separate reason for cancellation less than 24 hours before travel.
A booking 48 hours before travel requires a self-declaration.
Submit the journey-completion certificate within 72 hours after travel.
For unauthorised booking, check competent relaxation.

beats.heading: 03A  |  Approval before departure
beats.rule: Where SCoS and PM approval is required, the 2019 OM prescribes a 15-day / 5-day submission timeline.
beats.example: An eligible Secretary-level proposal requiring SCoS must reach the right authority on time.
beats.trap: 2016 clarification has training exceptions; the 2014 rule alone is not a safe shortcut.
beats.key: Political / other clearance, budget and current delegations must also be checked.
lines: Foreign visit के लिए competent approval और budget पहले check करें।
जहाँ Screening Committee और Prime Minister approval चाहिए,
proposal fifteen days पहले भेजें, और five days से late नहीं।
Example: Secretary का qualifying proposal time पर भेजना होगा।
Training और कुछ delegations के exceptions भी check करें।
english_lines: Check competent approval and budget before the foreign visit.
Where Screening Committee and Prime Minister approval is required,
send the proposal 15 days ahead and no later than five days ahead.
For example, a qualifying Secretary-level proposal must be submitted on time.
Also check exceptions for training and certain delegations.

beats.heading: 03B  |  Sponsor-funded is not a duplicate claim
beats.rule: For specified international-body / bilateral sponsorship, check para 19 and the sponsor terms.
beats.example: If an approved sponsor pays the airfare, do not also claim the same airfare from Government.
beats.trap: Do not assume all sponsored visits qualify or that every other cost is automatically payable.
beats.key: Approval, hospitality clearance and any other conditions are separate questions.
lines: कुछ international bodies या agreements में sponsor terms apply हो सकते हैं।
दोनों sets की allowances automatic जोड़ना सही नहीं है।
Example: sponsor ने flight pay की, तो वही fare दोबारा claim न करें।
Visit approval, hospitality और बाकी expenses अलग check होंगे।
english_lines: For some international bodies or agreements, sponsor terms may apply.
Do not automatically add both sets of allowances.
If the sponsor paid the flight, do not claim the same fare again.
Visit approval, hospitality and other expenses need separate checks.

beats.heading: 04A  |  Starting from India
beats.rule: For an India-posted officer touring abroad: first 14 days full, next 14 at 75%, thereafter 60%.
beats.example: With an assumed full rate of $100: day 15 is $75 before other applicable adjustments.
beats.trap: The example assumes a full qualifying day; cross-border and partial-day cases need checking.
beats.key: These are 2023 order slabs, not domestic food-allowance timing slabs.
lines: Latest MEA order जो हमें मिला, September twenty twenty three का है।
India से foreign tour पर पहले fourteen days full admissible rate।
Next fourteen days seventy five percent; फिर sixty percent।
Example: मान लें full rate hundred dollars है।
Qualifying day fifteen पर seventy five dollars बनेगा।
Partial day और बाकी adjustments अलग verify करें।
english_lines: The latest MEA order located is from September 2023.
For a foreign tour from India, the first 14 days are at the full admissible rate.
The next 14 days are at 75%; subsequent days are at 60%.
For example, assume the full rate is 100 dollars.
A qualifying day 15 gives 75 dollars before other adjustments.
Verify partial days and other adjustments separately.

beats.heading: 04B  |  Officers posted abroad
beats.rule: For the specified tours by officers posted abroad: first 7 days full, next 7 at 75%, then 50%.
beats.example: At an assumed full $100 rate, qualifying day 8 is $75 and day 15 is $50.
beats.trap: The 14-day India-posted schedule must not be substituted for this overseas-posted schedule.
beats.key: Check the order’s posting and tour conditions; do not assume a new clock at a border.
lines: अब overseas posted officers के specified tours का अलग schedule।
पहले seven days full; अगले seven days seventy five percent।
उसके बाद fifty percent of the full admissible rate।
Example: hundred dollars base पर day eight है seventy five।
Day fifteen है fifty dollars, बाकी applicable adjustments से पहले।
India और overseas schedules को mix मत करें।
english_lines: Now consider the different schedule for specified tours by overseas-posted officers.
The first seven days are full; the next seven days are 75%.
After that, the rate is 50% of the full admissible rate.
For example, at a 100-dollar base, day eight is 75 dollars.
Day fifteen is 50 dollars before other applicable adjustments.
Do not mix the India and overseas schedules.

sections.title: Foreign hotel, meals and incidental costs

beats.heading: 05A  |  Panel, cap and training visits
beats.rule: Use the approved hotel panel and actual room rental; the order specifies a no-panel city benchmark.
beats.example: A non-representational foreign seminar requires the one-step-lower hotel entitlement check.
beats.trap: Do not replace the panel system with the domestic rupee ceiling.
beats.key: Own arrangement or accommodation alone free: DA at the rate prescribed for the grade.
lines: Foreign hotel के लिए approved panel और actual rental check करें।
Room rental में service charges और taxes भी order में हैं।
No-panel city में capital city का relevant lowest rate check होगा।
Non-representational training में hotel entitlement एक step lower है।
Example: seminar के लिए normal panel की lower step confirm करें।
Domestic hotel limit को foreign hotel पर copy न करें।
english_lines: For a foreign hotel, check the approved panel and actual rental.
The order includes service charges and taxes in room rental.
In a no-panel city, check the relevant lowest rate in the capital city.
Non-representational training uses one step lower hotel entitlement.
For a seminar, confirm the lower step of the normal hotel panel.
Do not copy the domestic hotel limit into the foreign hotel rule.

beats.heading: 05B  |  Breakfast, State Guest and tips
beats.rule: Breakfast included in hotel charges reduces DA by 10%; State Guest plus all meals free gives 25%.
beats.example: A $100 applicable daily rate with only breakfast reduction gives $90 in this simple example.
beats.trap: Do not invent an order of overlapping reductions; ask the accounts authority.
beats.key: Tips are not separately reimbursable in addition to foreign DA under this order.
lines: Hotel charge में breakfast हो, तो daily allowance ten percent कम।
Example: hundred dollars पर सिर्फ ये reduction लगे तो ninety।
State Guest और सारे meals free हों, तो twenty five percent rate।
Tips के लिए daily allowance के ऊपर extra reimbursement नहीं।
एक से ज़्यादा deductions हों तो office से method confirm करें।
english_lines: If hotel charges include breakfast, daily allowance is reduced by 10%.
For example, 100 dollars becomes 90 if only this reduction applies.
A State Guest receiving all meals free gets 25% of the rate.
Tips are not separately reimbursed in addition to daily allowance.
When deductions overlap, confirm the method with the office.

sections.title: Foreign conveyance, currency and source check

beats.heading: 06A  |  Duty conveyance and currency
beats.rule: Necessary and reasonable duty conveyance is separate, subject to admissibility and specific sanction funds.
beats.example: A necessary taxi to an official meeting may be reimbursed if the sanction provides funds.
beats.trap: A private sightseeing taxi is not automatically official conveyance.
beats.key: Convertible local-currency equivalents use official MEA exchange rates via rupees.
lines: Foreign daily allowance में official-duty transport included नहीं है।
Necessary और reasonable conveyance अलग से check हो सकता है।
Sanction में इस खर्च के लिए specific funds होना भी ज़रूरी है।
Example: official meeting का eligible taxi bill separately देखें।
Sightseeing का taxi अपने आप official duty claim नहीं बनता।
Currency conversion के लिए official MEA rate check करें।
english_lines: Foreign daily allowance does not include transport for official duty.
Necessary and reasonable conveyance can be considered separately.
The sanction must also specifically provide funds for this cost.
For example, consider an eligible taxi to an official meeting separately.
A sightseeing taxi does not automatically become an official-duty claim.
Check the official MEA exchange rate for currency conversion.

beats.heading: 06B  |  Rate conflict: stop and verify
beats.rule: The located 2023 order gives Level 10+ the full annexure rate; Level 2–9 transcription conflicts.
beats.example: For a Level 7 claim, obtain a legible authoritative order before calculating that percentage.
beats.trap: A search dated 27 Oct 2026 cannot prove that no later MEA order exists.
beats.key: Level 1 is transcribed as 33%; verify the primary copy and your department’s latest adoption.
lines: Latest MEA order जो हमें मिला, September twenty twenty three का है।
Level ten और ऊपर annexure का full prescribed rate check करें।
Level two से nine में copies की percentage reading conflict करती है।
Example: Level seven का calculation legible official copy से verify करें।
Later amendment और departmental adoption भी check करें।
english_lines: The latest MEA order we located is from September 2023.
Level 10 and above checks the full prescribed annexure rate.
For Levels 2 to 9, copies conflict on the percentage reading.
For a Level 7 calculation, verify a legible official copy first.
Also check later amendments and departmental adoption.

beats.heading: 07A  |  Conventional sea / river steamer
beats.rule: Outside the island route table: Level 9+ highest; Level 6–8 lower where there are two classes.
beats.example: Level 5 on a three-class steamer uses middle / second class; with four classes, third.
beats.trap: The Level 6–8 row does not specify a three-class answer: do not invent one.
beats.key: Level 4–5: lower in two; middle in three; third in four. Level 3 or below: lowest.
lines: अब sea या river steamer का standard table।
Level nine और ऊपर highest; Level three और नीचे lowest class।
Level six से eight में दो classes हों तो lower class।
Level four और five में दो, तीन या चार classes अलग देखें।
Example: तीन classes में Level five के लिए middle या second।
Level six से eight के तीन-class case में office से पूछें।
english_lines: Now consider the standard sea or river steamer table.
Level nine and above is highest; Level three and below is lowest class.
For Levels six to eight, the lower class applies when there are two classes.
For Levels four and five, check the two-, three- and four-class cases separately.
For example, on a three-class steamer, Level five checks middle or second class.
Ask the office about a three-class case for Levels six to eight.

beats.heading: 07B  |  Mainland to island: SCI ships
beats.rule: For the specified mainland–A&N / Lakshadweep journeys on SCI-operated ships, a separate table applies.
beats.example: A Level 7 officer on a qualifying SCI ship checks First / A cabin.
beats.trap: Do not automatically extend this special SCI table to every ferry or operator.
beats.key: Confirm the operator, route, class availability, sanction and saving clause.
lines: Mainland और island के बीच qualifying SCI ship का अलग table।
Level nine और ऊपर Deluxe; six से eight First या A cabin।
Level four और five Second या B cabin; three और नीचे Bunk।
Example: eligible Level seven का SCI ship पर A cabin check होगा।
हर private ferry पर ये special table automatic नहीं लगाएँ।
english_lines: A separate table applies to qualifying SCI ships between mainland and islands.
Level nine and above is Deluxe; six to eight is First or A cabin.
Levels four and five are Second or B cabin; three and below is Bunk.
For example, an eligible Level seven checks A cabin on an SCI ship.
Do not apply this special table automatically to every private ferry.

beats.heading: 08A  |  Levels 6–13 and 14+
beats.rule: Level 14+: public bus including AC, prescribed AC taxi rate when used, or auto rate for listed modes.
beats.example: At a prescribed-rate place a Level 14 AC-taxi journey can use the applicable AC-taxi rate.
beats.trap: Levels 6–13 have the same row except AC taxi is not permissible.
beats.key: Auto rate for a listed mode is not the same as an unlimited taxi bill.
lines: जहाँ specific transport rates prescribed हैं, pay level देखें।
Level fourteen और ऊपर public AC bus भी ले सकते हैं।
AC taxi actually use हो, तो prescribed AC taxi rate देखें।
Listed modes पर prescribed auto rate वाला option भी है।
Example: Level fourteen AC taxi use करे तो relevant rate check होगा।
Level six से thirteen के लिए AC taxi permissible नहीं है।
english_lines: Where transport rates are prescribed, check the pay level.
Level fourteen and above may use a public AC bus.
When an AC taxi is actually used, check the prescribed AC-taxi rate.
The prescribed auto-rate option also applies to the listed modes.
For example, check the relevant rate when Level fourteen uses an AC taxi.
For Levels six to thirteen, AC taxi is not permissible under this table.

beats.heading: 08B  |  Levels 4–5 and 3 or below
cards: Not listed in 3 and below row
beats.rule: Level 4–5: public bus except AC or auto rate for listed modes; Level 3 and below: ordinary bus or listed auto modes.
beats.example: A Level 3 officer using ordinary public bus checks actual fare and the relevant route rule.
beats.trap: Own car is not expressly listed in the Level 3-and-below prescribed-rate row.
beats.key: Pay-level eligibility, applicable route cap and proof all remain relevant.
lines: Level four और five के लिए public bus, लेकिन AC bus नहीं।
Level three और नीचे ordinary public bus वाली row है।
Listed auto या own scooter जैसे modes पर auto rate देखें।
Example: Level three ordinary bus का actual fare check करेगा।
उस lower row में own car expressly listed नहीं है।
Route, sanction और proof के बाकी checks भी ज़रूरी हैं।
english_lines: For Levels four and five, public bus is allowed but not AC bus.
For Level three and below, the row specifies ordinary public bus.
For listed modes such as auto or own scooter, check the auto rate.
For example, Level three checks the actual ordinary bus fare.
Own car is not expressly listed in that lower row.
Route, sanction and proof checks are also needed.

beats.heading: 09A  |  No prescribed rate: indexed fallback
beats.rule: Only where the specified State / neighbouring State rates do not exist: base ₹24 / ₹12 per km.
beats.example: After the first 25% increase, an eligible 20 km auto example calculates 20 × ₹15 = ₹300.
beats.trap: The fallback calculation is not permission for every employee to use every vehicle.
beats.key: At 60% Dearness Allowance, a second 50-point trigger has not been crossed.
lines: State और neighbouring State दोनों की specific rate न हो, fallback देखें।
2017 base own car या taxi के लिए twenty four rupees per kilometre।
Auto या own scooter के लिए twelve rupees per kilometre।
पहली twenty five percent increase से thirty और fifteen बनते हैं।
Example: eligible auto में twenty kilometres का result three hundred।
ये result sanction, actual journey और mode eligibility के subject है।
english_lines: Where neither State nor neighbouring State has a specific rate, check the fallback.
The 2017 base is 24 rupees per kilometre for own car or taxi.
For auto or own scooter, the base is 12 rupees per kilometre.
After the first 25% increase, those become 30 and 15.
For example, 20 kilometres by eligible auto calculates to 300 rupees.
This result is subject to sanction, actual journey and mode eligibility.

beats.heading: 09B  |  Rail-connected versus not connected
beats.rule: No rail: AC bus for AC-II-or-above rail entitlement, Deluxe/ordinary for others.
beats.example: Rail-connected public bus fare ₹400 against entitled rail fare ₹500 meets this fare cap.
beats.trap: The public-transport train-fare cap must not automatically be imposed on every private-vehicle claim.
beats.key: Check fare proof, route, class, sanction, saving clause and any other applicable rules.
lines: जहाँ rail नहीं है, eligible AC Two और ऊपर वालों के लिए AC bus।
बाकी के लिए Deluxe या ordinary bus का rule देखें।
Rail-connected route पर public transport का fare train class से capped है।
Example: bus four hundred, entitled train five hundred।
इस public-fare example में cap cross नहीं हुआ।
Private vehicle claims पर वही clause automatic मत लगाएँ।
english_lines: Where there is no rail, AC bus applies for those entitled to AC Two and above.
For others, check the Deluxe or ordinary bus rule.
On a rail-connected route, public transport fare is capped by entitled-class train fare.
For example, bus fare is 400 and entitled train fare is 500.
In this public-fare example, the cap has not been crossed.
Do not apply that exact clause automatically to private-vehicle claims.

beats.heading: 10A  |  Personal effects are a different component
beats.rule: Transfer effects are distinct from the traveller’s road mileage; Level 6+ base ₹50 indexes to ₹62.50/km.
beats.example: For an eligible 50 km transfer, 50 × ₹62.50 = ₹3,125 is a ceiling calculation, not automatic payment.
beats.trap: Regional one-third no-receipt exception is conditional, not a blanket receipt waiver.
beats.key: *First 25% indexed calculation; verify applicability, actual transport and evidence.
lines: Road पर employee की journey और transfer effects अलग components हैं।
Level six और ऊपर effects का base fifty rupees per kilometre था।
पहली increase के बाद calculation sixty two point five zero है।
Example: fifty kilometres का ceiling calculation देखें।
Result है three thousand one hundred twenty five rupees।
Actual transport, receipt और applicable exception अलग check करें।
ये calculated ceiling अपने आप payment नहीं है।
english_lines: Road travel by the employee and transfer effects are separate components.
For Level six and above, the effects base was 50 rupees per kilometre.
After the first increase, the calculation is 62 rupees 50 paise.
For example, consider the ceiling calculation for 50 kilometres.
The calculated result is 3,125 rupees.
Check actual transport, receipts and any applicable exception separately.
This calculated ceiling is not an automatic payment.

beats.heading: 10B  |  Government boats and scientific field work
beats.rule: The special Government-boat / remote scientific-field provision requires its stated conditions and approval.
beats.example: A qualifying survey on a Government boat needs the food-rate-equivalent DA approval checked.
beats.trap: This is not a blanket rule for every private boat or all remote travel.
beats.key: Foot mileage and its indexed rate are a separate question under para 2(E)(iii).
lines: Government boats और remote scientific field work का special rule है।
Qualifying case में daily allowance food-rate के बराबर हो सकता है।
Head या controlling officer की approval और conditions check करें।
Example: approved survey का Government boat journey अलग assess होगा।
Foot mileage और उसकी indexed rate भी अलग check हैं।
Detailed sources और pending verification companion guide में हैं।
english_lines: There is a special rule for Government boats and remote scientific field work.
In a qualifying case, daily allowance can be equivalent to the food rate.
Check the Head or controlling officer approval and conditions.
For example, an approved survey journey on a Government boat is assessed separately.
Foot mileage and its indexed rate are separate checks.
Detailed sources and pending verification are in the companion guide.

narration_lines_status: Synthesis text; chapter 04 opening was assembled from the same selected-voice chapter 06 after a 2023 recognition ambiguity. No human-verbatim audio review.
